segments.text: 各位观众,今天给大家带来的是 ACM MobiSys 2021 的论文《PPFL: privacy-preserving federated learning with trusted execution environments》。
这篇论文由 Fan Mo、Hamed Haddadi 等作者完成,目前已经被引用 222 次,研究方向涉及Privacy-Preserving Technologies in Data、Adversarial Robustness in Machine Learning、Cryptography and Data Security。
用论文自己的话来说:We propose and implement a Privacy-preserving Federated Learning ( PPFL ) framework for mobile systems to limit privacy leakages in federated learning.
如果你想快速抓住重点,可以记住这几个关键词:Privacy-Preserving Technologies in Data、Adversarial Robustness in Machine Learning、Cryptography and Data Security。
